name: LAB-Bench FigQA
intro: LAB-Bench FigQA 是 LAB-Bench 的 226 题科学图像推理子集。生物学专家从论文图像中编写只能依靠图像回答、需要综合多个视觉元素且不能由图中文字直接解出的多项选择题。
build_method: 生物学专家编写与多轮审核
task_type: 科学图像多项选择问答
eval_feature: 仅图像可回答, 多元素推理
intro_en: LAB-Bench FigQA is LAB-Bench's 226-question scientific-figure reasoning subset. Biology experts write multiple-choice questions that can be answered only from the figure, require integration across multiple visual elements, and cannot be solved merely by reading text inside the image.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the FigQA-specific process in arXiv:2407.10362v3 Appendix C.3 and official futurehouse/lab-bench snapshot 5c77cec. FigQA is a LAB-Bench subset rather than a separate 2025 benchmark. Authors select papers and figures; contracted staff assemble a paper pool; a separate LabelBox annotation pass isolates the figure, caption, relationship boxes, and DOI; and author or contracted biology experts draft the question, ideal answer, and plausible distractors. GPT-4 Turbo suggestions may be used only for brainstorming and are corrected because they are frequently inaccurate or too easy. Every question must be answerable from the figure alone, not from the caption or paper text, not by simply reading text inside the image, and must integrate multiple figure elements. Calibration and continuing review yield 226 total questions, with 181 currently public and 45 private. Models receive only the figure and MCQ, run no-tool zero-shot chain of thought with an insufficient-information option, and are scored by accuracy, precision, and coverage over three runs.
